reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: This app used to work great. Now it’s not giving me any info of how to adjust my levels based off my tests.

reviews.title: No way to get in touch with the app’s developer
reviews.text:
Been using the paid version of the app for years, now won’t allow to log on to my account. Tells me invalid password no matter how many times I try to reset it.
Someone please correct, should really have a CONTACT US Link

reviews.title: Is anyone supporting this app???
reviews.text:
I have used poolcalculator.com for years.  Loved it.  Just bought this app.  Doesn’t work.  

Just get 
Error: Pool failed to load
   OR
Error: Account failed to load.  

Click through to app support and it takes me to the website where the is NO link to any app support.  

So far a waste of money.  

Is there an owner/developer who cares or do they just want our $5???
